(* ========================================================================================================= *)
(* 1. SIL-3 HARDWARE INTERLOCK EVALUATION & SAFETY WORD ENCODING                              *)
(* ========================================================================================================= *)
wSafetyInterlockWord.0  := bEmergencyStop;                  (* Bit 0: Hardware E-Stop Circuit OK *)

wSafetyInterlockWord.4  := (rH2SupplyPressure_bar < 48.0);  (* Bit 4: H2 Supply Header Within Maximum Proof Pressure *)
wSafetyInterlockWord.5  := NOT bStressInterlockLatched;     (* Bit 5: Vessel Dilatometry Stress Permissive *)
wSafetyInterlockWord.6  := NOT bThermalRunawayLatched;      (* Bit 6: Metal Hydride Core Thermal Exotherm Safe *)
wSafetyInterlockWord.7  := NOT bHydrogenLeakDetected;       (* Bit 7: Enclosure Lower Flammability Limit (<10% LFL) *)

wSafetyInterlockWord.11 := (rBedPressure_bar_ChA < 45.0);   (* Bit 11: Chamber Absolute Pressure Below Rupture Disk *)

wSafetyInterlockWord.13 := TRUE;                            (* Bit 13: Reserved Interlock Bus B *)

(* Master Readiness Logic: Essential Safety Bits (0..8) must be TRUE *)
bSystemReady := ((wSafetyInterlockWord AND 16#01FF) = 16#01FF) AND bMasterEnable;

(* Fail-Safe Emergency Shutdown Relay Actuation *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop OR bThermalRunawayLatched OR bHydrogenLeakDetected THEN
    bH2SafetyShutoffValve_Cmd  := FALSE; (* De-energize to trip *)
    bAlarmCriticalTrip         := TRUE;

END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================================= *)
(* 2. 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHMS                          *)
(* ========================================================================================================= *)
(* --- A. Hydrogen Bed Pressure 2oo3 Voting --- *)
rPress_Dev_AB := ABS(rBedPressure_bar_ChA - rBedPressure_bar_ChB);
rPress_Dev_BC := ABS(rBedPressure_bar_ChB - rBedPressure_bar_ChC);
rPress_Dev_CA := ABS(rBedPressure_bar_ChC - rBedPressure_bar_ChA);

bPress_ChA_Healthy := (rBedPressure_bar_ChA >= 0.0) AND (rBedPressure_bar_ChA <= 55.0);
bPress_ChB_Healthy := (rBedPressure_bar_ChB >= 0.0) AND (rBedPressure_bar_ChB <= 55.0);
bPress_ChC_Healthy := (rBedPressure_bar_ChC >= 0.0) AND (rBedPressure_bar_ChC <= 55.0);

(* Cross-channel discrepancy checks *)
IF (rPress_Dev_AB > rPressMaxDiscrepancy_bar) AND (rPress_Dev_CA > rPressMaxDiscrepancy_bar) THEN
    bPress_ChA_Healthy := FALSE; (* Channel A isolated as outlier *)
ELSIF (rPress_Dev_AB > rPressMaxDiscrepancy_bar) AND (rPress_Dev_BC > rPressMaxDiscrepancy_bar) THEN
    bPress_ChB_Healthy := FALSE; (* Channel B isolated as outlier *)
ELSIF (rPress_Dev_BC > rPressMaxDiscrepancy_bar) AND (rPress_Dev_CA > rPressMaxDiscrepancy_bar) THEN
    bPress_ChC_Healthy := FALSE; (* Channel C isolated as outlier *)
END_IF;

(* Full 2oo3 Median-of-Three or Degraded 2oo2 / 1oo1 Selection *)
IF bPress_ChA_Healthy AND bPress_ChB_Healthy AND bPress_ChC_Healthy THEN
    (* Pristine 2oo3: Exact Median Value *)
    rVotedBedPressure_bar := MAX(
        MIN(rBedPressure_bar_ChA, rBedPressure_bar_ChB),
        MIN(MAX(rBedPressure_bar_ChA, rBedPressure_bar_ChB), rBedPressure_bar_ChC)
    );
ELSIF bPress_ChA_Healthy AND bPress_ChB_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedPressure_bar := (rBedPressure_bar_ChA + rBedPressure_bar_ChB) * 0.5;
    bSingleChannelFailure := TRUE;
ELSIF bPress_ChB_Healthy AND bPress_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedPressure_bar := (rBedPressure_bar_ChB + rBedPressure_bar_ChC) * 0.5;
    bSingleChannelFailure := TRUE;
ELSIF bPress_ChA_Healthy AND bPress_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedPressure_bar := (rBedPressure_bar_ChA + rBedPressure_bar_ChC) * 0.5;
    bSingleChannelFailure := TRUE;
ELSIF bPress_ChA_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedPressure_bar := rBedPressure_bar_ChA;
    bDualChannelFailure   := TRUE;
ELSIF bPress_ChB_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedPressure_bar := rBedPressure_bar_ChB;
    bDualChannelFailure   := TRUE;
ELSIF bPress_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedPressure_bar := rBedPressure_bar_ChC;
    bDualChannelFailure   := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVotedBedPressure_bar := 50.0; (* Fail-safe trip overpressure *)
    bAlarmCriticalTrip    := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --- B. Hydride Bed Core Temperature 2oo3 Voting --- *)
rTemp_Dev_AB := ABS(rBedTemp_DegC_ChA - rBedTemp_DegC_ChB);
rTemp_Dev_BC := ABS(rBedTemp_DegC_ChB - rBedTemp_DegC_ChC);
rTemp_Dev_CA := ABS(rBedTemp_DegC_ChC - rBedTemp_DegC_ChA);

bTemp_ChA_Healthy := (rBedTemp_DegC_ChA >= -30.0) AND (rBedTemp_DegC_ChA <= 120.0);
bTemp_ChB_Healthy := (rBedTemp_DegC_ChB >= -30.0) AND (rBedTemp_DegC_ChB <= 120.0);
bTemp_ChC_Healthy := (rBedTemp_DegC_ChC >= -30.0) AND (rBedTemp_DegC_ChC <= 120.0);

IF (rTemp_Dev_AB > rTempMaxDiscrepancy_DegC) AND (rTemp_Dev_CA > rTempMaxDiscrepancy_DegC) THEN
    bTemp_ChA_Healthy := FALSE;
ELSIF (rTemp_Dev_AB > rTempMaxDiscrepancy_DegC) AND (rTemp_Dev_BC > rTempMaxDiscrepancy_DegC) THEN
    bTemp_ChB_Healthy := FALSE;
ELSIF (rTemp_Dev_BC > rTempMaxDiscrepancy_DegC) AND (rTemp_Dev_CA > rTempMaxDiscrepancy_DegC) THEN
    bTemp_ChC_Healthy := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF bTemp_ChA_Healthy AND bTemp_ChB_Healthy AND bTemp_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_DegC := MAX(
        MIN(rBedTemp_DegC_ChA, rBedTemp_DegC_ChB),
        MIN(MAX(rBedTemp_DegC_ChA, rBedTemp_DegC_ChB), rBedTemp_DegC_ChC)
    );
ELSIF bTemp_ChA_Healthy AND bTemp_ChB_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_DegC := (rBedTemp_DegC_ChA + rBedTemp_DegC_ChB) * 0.5;
    bSingleChannelFailure := TRUE;
ELSIF bTemp_ChB_Healthy AND bTemp_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_DegC := (rBedTemp_DegC_ChB + rBedTemp_DegC_ChC) * 0.5;
    bSingleChannelFailure := TRUE;
ELSIF bTemp_ChA_Healthy AND bTemp_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_DegC := (rBedTemp_DegC_ChA + rBedTemp_DegC_ChC) * 0.5;
    bSingleChannelFailure := TRUE;
ELSIF bTemp_ChA_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_DegC := rBedTemp_DegC_ChA;
    bDualChannelFailure   := TRUE;
ELSIF bTemp_ChB_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_DegC := rBedTemp_DegC_ChB;
    bDualChannelFailure   := TRUE;
ELSIF bTemp_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_DegC := rBedTemp_DegC_ChC;
    bDualChannelFailure   := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVotedBedTemp_DegC := 95.0; (* Overheat fail-safe fallback *)
    bAlarmCriticalTrip := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --- C. Structural Dilatometry Hoop Stress 2oo3 Voting --- *)
rStress_Dev_AB := ABS(rWallStress_MPa_ChA - rWallStress_MPa_ChB);
rStress_Dev_BC := ABS(rWallStress_MPa_ChB - rWallStress_MPa_ChC);
rStress_Dev_CA := ABS(rWallStress_MPa_ChC - rWallStress_MPa_ChA);

bStress_ChA_Healthy := (rWallStress_MPa_ChA >= -10.0) AND (rWallStress_MPa_ChA <= 250.0);
bStress_ChB_Healthy := (rWallStress_MPa_ChB >= -10.0) AND (rWallStress_MPa_ChB <= 250.0);
bStress_ChC_Healthy := (rWallStress_MPa_ChC >= -10.0) AND (rWallStress_MPa_ChC <= 250.0);

IF (rStress_Dev_AB > rStressMaxDiscrepancy_MPa) AND (rStress_Dev_CA > rStressMaxDiscrepancy_MPa) THEN
    bStress_ChA_Healthy := FALSE;
ELSIF (rStress_Dev_AB > rStressMaxDiscrepancy_MPa) AND (rStress_Dev_BC > rStressMaxDiscrepancy_MPa) THEN
    bStress_ChB_Healthy := FALSE;
ELSIF (rStress_Dev_BC > rStressMaxDiscrepancy_MPa) AND (rStress_Dev_CA > rStressMaxDiscrepancy_MPa) THEN
    bStress_ChC_Healthy := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF bStress_ChA_Healthy AND bStress_ChB_Healthy AND bStress_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedWallStress_MPa := MAX(
        MIN(rWallStress_MPa_ChA, rWallStress_MPa_ChB),
        MIN(MAX(rWallStress_MPa_ChA, rWallStress_MPa_ChB), rWallStress_MPa_ChC)
    );
ELSIF bStress_ChA_Healthy AND bStress_ChB_Healthy THEN
    rVotedWallStress_MPa := (rWallStress_MPa_ChA + rWallStress_MPa_ChB) * 0.5;
    bSingleChannelFailure := TRUE;
ELSIF bStress_ChB_Healthy AND bStress_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedWallStress_MPa := (rWallStress_MPa_ChB + rWallStress_MPa_ChC) * 0.5;
    bSingleChannelFailure := TRUE;
ELSIF bStress_ChA_Healthy AND bStress_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedWallStress_MPa := (rWallStress_MPa_ChA + rWallStress_MPa_ChC) * 0.5;
    bSingleChannelFailure := TRUE;
ELSIF bStress_ChA_Healthy THEN
    rVotedWallStress_MPa := rWallStress_MPa_ChA;
    bDualChannelFailure   := TRUE;
ELSIF bStress_ChB_Healthy THEN
    rVotedWallStress_MPa := rWallStress_MPa_ChB;
    bDualChannelFailure   := TRUE;
ELSIF bStress_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedWallStress_MPa := rWallStress_MPa_ChC;
    bDualChannelFailure   := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVotedWallStress_MPa := 220.0; (* Overstress fail-safe fallback *)
    bAlarmCriticalTrip   := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* TMR Health Telemetry Word Construction *)
wTmrDiagnosticWord.0 := bPress_ChA_Healthy;
wTmrDiagnosticWord.1 := bPress_ChB_Healthy;
wTmrDiagnosticWord.2 := bPress_ChC_Healthy;
wTmrDiagnosticWord.3 := bTemp_ChA_Healthy;
wTmrDiagnosticWord.4 := bTemp_ChB_Healthy;
wTmrDiagnosticWord.5 := bTemp_ChC_Healthy;
wTmrDiagnosticWord.6 := bStress_ChA_Healthy;
wTmrDiagnosticWord.7 := bStress_ChB_Healthy;
wTmrDiagnosticWord.8 := bStress_ChC_Healthy;
wTmrDiagnosticWord.9 := NOT bSingleChannelFailure;
wTmrDiagnosticWord.10 := NOT bDualChannelFailure;
bDegradedModeActive := bSingleChannelFailure AND NOT bDualChannelFailure;

(* ========================================================================================================= *)
(* 3. DYNAMIC VAN 'T HOFF EQUILIBRIUM & REACTION KINETIC OBSERVER                            *)
(* ========================================================================================================= *)
rBedTemp_Kelvin := rVotedBedTemp_DegC + 273.15;
IF rBedTemp_Kelvin < 240.0 THEN
    rBedTemp_Kelvin := 240.0; (* Prevent division by cryogenic singularity *)
END_IF;

(* Distinguish Absorption vs Desorption Thermodynamics via Net Mass Flow *)
IF rH2MassFlow_Nm3h > 0.05 THEN
    (* Absorption Exothermic Mode *)
    rReactionDirectionSign := 1.0;
    (* Van 't Hoff Equation: ln(Peq/P0) = (dH_abs / (R * T)) - (dS_abs / R) + HysteresisOffset *)
    rVanTHoffExpTerm := (rEnthalpyAbsorption_J_mol / (rGasConstant_R * rBedTemp_Kelvin)) - (rEntropyAbsorption_J_molK / rGasConstant_R) + (rHysteresisFactor * 0.5);
ELSIF rFuelCellDemandFlow_Nm3h > 0.05 THEN
    (* Desorption Endothermic Mode *)
    rReactionDirectionSign := -1.0;
    (* Van 't Hoff Equation: ln(Peq/P0) = (dH_des / (R * T)) - (dS_des / R) - HysteresisOffset *)
    rVanTHoffExpTerm := (-rEnthalpyDesorption_J_mol / (rGasConstant_R * rBedTemp_Kelvin)) + (rEntropyDesorption_J_molK / rGasConstant_R) - (rHysteresisFactor * 0.5);
ELSE
    (* Static Isothermal Idle Equilibrium *)
    rReactionDirectionSign := 0.0;
    rVanTHoffExpTerm := (rEnthalpyAbsorption_J_mol / (rGasConstant_R * rBedTemp_Kelvin)) - (rEntropyAbsorption_J_molK / rGasConstant_R);
END_IF;

(* Non-ideal PCI Plateau Slope Correction Polynomial: phi(SoC) *)
(* Real metal hydride isotherms exhibit a non-zero slope and inflection at two-phase limits *)
rPlateauSlopeCorrection := 0.240 * (aStateEstimate_xHat[3] - 0.50);
IF aStateEstimate_xHat[3] > 0.85 THEN
    (* Alpha + Beta -> Beta phase saturation steep pressure rise *)
    rPlateauSlopeCorrection := rPlateauSlopeCorrection + (1.85 * (aStateEstimate_xHat[3] - 0.85));
ELSIF aStateEstimate_xHat[3] < 0.15 THEN
    (* Alpha solid-solution region depression *)
    rPlateauSlopeCorrection := rPlateauSlopeCorrection - (1.45 * (0.15 - aStateEstimate_xHat[3]));
END_IF;

(* Calculate Equilibrium Plateau Pressure via Exponentiation *)
rEquilibriumPlateauPress_bar := rStandardPressure_bar * EXP(LIMIT(-4.0, rVanTHoffExpTerm + rPlateauSlopeCorrection, 5.0));
rPlateauOverpressure_bar := rVotedBedPressure_bar - rEquilibriumPlateauPress_bar;

(* Real-time Sized Sorption Enthalpy Generation / Absorption Heat Flux [kW] *)
(* 1 Nm3 H2 = 44.64 mol H2 -> Enthalpy Rate = Flow * 44.64 * abs(dH) / 3600 *)
rReactionEnthalpyFlow_kW := (ABS(rH2MassFlow_Nm3h) * 44.643 * ABS(rEnthalpyAbsorption_J_mol)) / 3600000.0;

(* ========================================================================================================= *)
(* 4. DILATOMETRY EXPANSION INTERLOCK & POWDER COMPACTION OBSERVER                           *)
(* ========================================================================================================= *)
(* Dynamic Strain Rate Differentiator dSigma/dt [MPa/s] *)
IF rScanCycleTime_Sec > 0.001 THEN
    rRawStressDerivative := (rVotedWallStress_MPa - rPrevVotedStress_MPa) / rScanCycleTime_Sec;
    rFilteredStressRate_MPa_s := (rStrainRateFilterAlpha * rRawStressDerivative) + ((1.0 - rStrainRateFilterAlpha) * rFilteredStressRate_MPa_s);
    rPrevVotedStress_MPa := rVotedWallStress_MPa;
    (* Convert Hoop Stress Rate to Microstrain Rate: deps/dt = dsigma/dt / E * 1e6 *)
    rDilatometryStrainRate_ue_s := (rFilteredStressRate_MPa_s / rYoungsModulus_Vessel_MPa) * 1000000.0;
END_IF;

(* Estimated Metal Hydride Lattice Volumetric Expansion (%) *)
rLatticeVolExpansion_Pct := aStateEstimate_xHat[3] * rCompactionLatticeExpansionRate * 100.0;

(* Multi-Tier Dilatometry Protection Interlocks *)
IF rVotedWallStress_MPa >= rStressCriticalTrip_MPa THEN
    (* SIL-3 Critical Trip: Hard plastic deformation prevention *)
    bStressInterlockLatched := TRUE;
    nHighStressEventsCounter := nHighStressEventsCounter + 1;
    rH2ChargeControlValve_Pct := 0.0; (* Immediate isolate hydriding *)
    iOperatingState := 90;            (* Jump to Stress Mitigation Backoff *)
ELSIF (rVotedWallStress_MPa >= rStressWarningLimit_MPa) OR (rDilatometryStrainRate_ue_s > 45.0) THEN
    (* Pre-trip warning: Dynamic hydriding flow derating *)
    wAlarmAggregatedWord.5 := TRUE;   (* Set High Vessel Dilatometry Stress Warning *)
ELSE
    wAlarmAggregatedWord.5 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================================= *)
(* 5. FULL STATE-SPACE OBSERVER & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL OPTIMIZER                         *)
(* ========================================================================================================= *)
(* Assemble Observation Vector y[1..4] from 2oo3 Validated Sensors *)
aSensorMeasurement_y[1] := rVotedBedTemp_DegC;
aSensorMeasurement_y[2] := rCoolantReturnTemp_DegC;
aSensorMeasurement_y[3] := rVotedBedPressure_bar;
aSensorMeasurement_y[4] := rVotedWallStress_MPa;

(* A. Luenberger Observer Innovation Residual: e_y = y - C * x_hat *)
FOR iLoopIndexI := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iLoopIndexJ := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aMatrix_C[iLoopIndexI, iLoopIndexJ] * aStateEstimate_xHat[iLoopIndexJ]);
    END_FOR;
    aObserverResidual_eY[iLoopIndexI] := aSensorMeasurement_y[iLoopIndexI] - rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* B. State Vector Prediction & Correction Update: x_hat[k+1] = A * x_hat + B * u + L * e_y *)
FOR iLoopIndexI := 1 TO 6 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iLoopIndexJ := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aMatrix_A[iLoopIndexI, iLoopIndexJ] * aStateEstimate_xHat[iLoopIndexJ]);
    END_FOR;
    (* Add input coupling B * u *)
    FOR iLoopIndexK := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aMatrix_B[iLoopIndexI, iLoopIndexK] * aControl_u[iLoopIndexK]);
    END_FOR;
    (* Add observer correction L * e_y *)
    FOR iLoopIndexK := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aMatrix_L[iLoopIndexI, iLoopIndexK] * aObserverResidual_eY[iLoopIndexK]);
    END_FOR;
    aStateEstimate_xHat[iLoopIndexI] := rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Saturate Physical Limits on Estimated States *)
aStateEstimate_xHat[3] := LIMIT(0.0, aStateEstimate_xHat[3], 1.0);  (* State of Charge [%] *)
aStateEstimate_xHat[6] := LIMIT(0.0, aStateEstimate_xHat[6], 1.0);  (* PCM Molten Fraction [%] *)
rCurrentStateOfCharge_Pct := aStateEstimate_xHat[3] * 100.0;
rPCMLiquidFraction_Pct   := aStateEstimate_xHat[6] * 100.0;
rNetStoredH2Mass_kg       := aStateEstimate_xHat[3] * rMaxStorageCapacity_kg;

(* C. Update Target Reference Trajectories & Error Vector *)
aStateTarget_xRef[3] := LIMIT(0.05, rTargetSoC_Pct / 100.0, 0.98);
IF iOperatingState = 40 THEN
    (* Hydriding Absorption Target Operating Window *)
    aStateTarget_xRef[1] := 32.0; (* Optimal reaction plateau temperature [deg C] *)
    aStateTarget_xRef[4] := rEquilibriumPlateauPress_bar + 4.5; (* 4.5 bar driving overpressure *)
    aStateTarget_xRef[5] := 115.0; (* Controlled safe dilatometry stress *)
ELSIF iOperatingState = 70 THEN
    (* Dehydriding Desorption Target Operating Window *)
    aStateTarget_xRef[1] := 55.0; (* Elevated temperature to boost desorption plateau *)
    aStateTarget_xRef[4] := MAX(rMinFuelCellDeliveryPress_bar + 1.2, 5.0);
    aStateTarget_xRef[5] := 45.0; (* Relaxed stress state during discharge *)
ELSE
    aStateTarget_xRef[1] := 22.0;
    aStateTarget_xRef[4] := 10.0;
    aStateTarget_xRef[5] := 25.0;
END_IF;

FOR iLoopIndexI := 1 TO 6 DO
    aStateTrackingError[iLoopIndexI] := aStateEstimate_xHat[iLoopIndexI] - aStateTarget_xRef[iLoopIndexI];
END_FOR;

(* D. Real-Time Model Predictive Control (Active-Set Projected Gradient Descent) *)
(* Quadratic Cost: J = 0.5 * eX^T * Q * eX + 0.5 * u^T * R * u + 0.5 * du^T * S * du *)
FOR iMpcIter := 1 TO 12 DO
    (* 1. Forward 1-Step Prediction under Current Control Estimate *)
    FOR iLoopIndexI := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := 0.0;
        FOR iLoopIndexJ := 1 TO 6 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (aMatrix_A[iLoopIndexI, iLoopIndexJ] * aStateEstimate_xHat[iLoopIndexJ]);
        END_FOR;
        FOR iLoopIndexK := 1 TO 3 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (aMatrix_B[iLoopIndexI, iLoopIndexK] * aControl_u[iLoopIndexK]);
        END_FOR;
        aStatePredict_xPred[iLoopIndexI] := rTempSum;
    END_FOR;

    (* 2. Analytical Gradient Computation: grad_J = B^T * Q * (x_pred - x_ref) + R * u + S * (u - u_prev) *)
    FOR iLoopIndexK := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempSum := 0.0;
        FOR iLoopIndexI := 1 TO 6 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (aMatrix_B[iLoopIndexI, iLoopIndexK] * aWeights_Q[iLoopIndexI] * (aStatePredict_xPred[iLoopIndexI] - aStateTarget_xRef[iLoopIndexI]));
        END_FOR;
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aWeights_R[iLoopIndexK] * aControl_u[iLoopIndexK]);
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aWeights_S[iLoopIndexK] * (aControl_u[iLoopIndexK] - aControl_uPrev[iLoopIndexK]));
        aMpcGradient[iLoopIndexK] := rTempSum;
    END_FOR;

    (* 3. Projected Gradient Descent Update with Dilatometry Wall Stress Back-off *)
    FOR iLoopIndexK := 1 TO 3 DO
        rMpcTempControlVal := aControl_u[iLoopIndexK] - (rMpcStepSize * aMpcGradient[iLoopIndexK]);
        (* Enforce Hard Actuator Polyhedral Box Saturation *)
        IF iLoopIndexK = 1 THEN
            (* Hydrogen Flow Throttle Valve [0..100 %] *)
            IF rVotedWallStress_MPa > rStressWarningLimit_MPa THEN
                (* Dynamic Dilatometry Clamping to Relieve Compaction Stress *)
                rMpcTempControlVal := MIN(rMpcTempControlVal, 35.0);
            END_IF;
            aControl_u[1] := LIMIT(0.0, rMpcTempControlVal, 100.0);
        ELSIF iLoopIndexK = 2 THEN
            (* Coolant Circulation Pump [15..100 %] *)
            aControl_u[2] := LIMIT(15.0, rMpcTempControlVal, 100.0);
        ELSE
            (* Thermal Sync 3-Way Valve [0=Chiller, 100=Heater] *)
            aControl_u[3] := LIMIT(0.0, rMpcTempControlVal, 100.0);
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Record Control Slew Rate & Update Historic Memory *)
FOR iLoopIndexK := 1 TO 3 DO
    aControl_Delta_u[iLoopIndexK] := aControl_u[iLoopIndexK] - aControl_uPrev[iLoopIndexK];
    aControl_uPrev[iLoopIndexK]   := aControl_u[iLoopIndexK];
END_FOR;

(* ========================================================================================================= *)
(* 6. FINITE STATE MACHINE PROCESS SEQUENCER (CASE 0 TO 99)                                  *)
(* ========================================================================================================= *)
wSystemOperatingWord := INT_TO_WORD(iOperatingState);

CASE iOperatingState OF
    0: (* ---------------- COLD INERT STANDBY & IDLE ---------------- *)
        bH2SafetyShutoffValve_Cmd       := FALSE;
        rH2ChargeControlValve_Pct       := 0.0;
        rH2DischargeControlValve_Pct    := 0.0;
        rCoolantPumpDemand_Pct          := 15.0; (* Keep minimum anti-stagnation circulation *)
        rCoolant3WayValve_Pct           := 50.0;
        rAuxHeatingDemand_kW            := 0.0;
        bInertGasPurgeValve_Cmd         := FALSE;
        bEmergencyDepressValve_Cmd      := FALSE;
        bChillerBypassContactor_Cmd     := FALSE;
        
        IF bMasterEnable AND bSystemReady THEN
            iOperatingState := 10; (* Transition to Preflight Self-Test *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* ---------------- PREFLIGHT SELF-TEST & 2oo3 VERIFICATION ---------------- *)
        bH2SafetyShutoffValve_Cmd       := FALSE;
        rCoolantPumpDemand_Pct          := 40.0;
        
        tEquilibrationSoakTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#10S);
        
        IF tEquilibrationSoakTimer.Q THEN
            tEquilibrationSoakTimer(IN := FALSE);
            IF (wTmrDiagnosticWord AND 16#01FF) = 16#01FF THEN
                (* All 9 primary instrumentation channels confirmed healthy *)
                iOperatingState := 20;
            ELSIF bSingleChannelFailure THEN
                (* Acceptable degraded start with operator notice *)
                iOperatingState := 20;
            ELSE
                bAlarmCriticalTrip := TRUE;
                iOperatingState    := 99;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    20: (* ---------------- INERT NITROGEN PURGE & SYSTEM DE-OXYGENATION ---------------- *)
        (* Protect active Ti-Mn surface from oxidation/poisoning *)
        bInertGasPurgeValve_Cmd         := TRUE;
        bH2SafetyShutoffValve_Cmd       := FALSE;
        rH2ChargeControlValve_Pct       := 0.0;
        rCoolantPumpDemand_Pct          := 25.0;
        
        tInertPurgeTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#45S);
        
        IF tInertPurgeTimer.Q THEN
            tInertPurgeTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bInertGasPurgeValve_Cmd := FALSE;
            iOperatingState         := 25; (* Transition to H2 Priming *)
        END_IF;

    25: (* ---------------- HYDROGEN HEADER PRIMING & EQUILIBRATION ---------------- *)
        bH2SafetyShutoffValve_Cmd       := TRUE; (* Energize fast double-block solenoid *)
        rH2ChargeControlValve_Pct       := 5.0;  (* Crack open for smooth pressurization *)
        rCoolantPumpDemand_Pct          := 30.0;
        
        tEquilibrationSoakTimer(IN := (rVotedBedPressure_bar >= 2.5), PT := T#15S);
        
        IF tEquilibrationSoakTimer.Q THEN
            tEquilibrationSoakTimer(IN := FALSE);
            IF rTargetSoC_Pct > (rCurrentStateOfCharge_Pct + 2.0) THEN
                iOperatingState := 30; (* Demand: Charge Storage *)
            ELSIF bFuelCellRunPermit AND (rFuelCellDemandFlow_Nm3h > 0.1) THEN
                iOperatingState := 60; (* Demand: Discharge to Fuel Cell *)
            ELSE
                iOperatingState := 50; (* Demand: Charged Idle Standby *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    30: (* ---------------- ABSORPTION PRE-COOLING & PCM CHILLDOWN ---------------- *)
        (* Prime the multi-plate heat exchanger and solidify PCM before exothermic surge *)
        bH2SafetyShutoffValve_Cmd       := TRUE;
        rH2ChargeControlValve_Pct       := 0.0;
        rCoolant3WayValve_Pct           := 0.0;   (* 100% Chiller Cooling Loop *)
        rCoolantPumpDemand_Pct          := 85.0;  (* High velocity heat removal *)
        rAuxHeatingDemand_kW            := 0.0;
        
        tEquilibrationSoakTimer(IN := (rVotedBedTemp_DegC <= 26.0), PT := T#20S);
        
        IF tEquilibrationSoakTimer.Q THEN
            tEquilibrationSoakTimer(IN := FALSE);
            nTotalAbsorptionCycles := nTotalAbsorptionCycles + 1;
            iOperatingState        := 40; (* Enter Hydriding Bulk Plateau *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* ---------------- HYDRIDING EXOTHERMIC BULK ABSORPTION (MPC CLOSED-LOOP) ---------------- *)
        bH2SafetyShutoffValve_Cmd       := TRUE;
        bInertGasPurgeValve_Cmd         := FALSE;
        bEmergencyDepressValve_Cmd      := FALSE;
        
        (* Assign Actuators from Real-Time Model Predictive Controller *)
        rH2ChargeControlValve_Pct       := aControl_u[1];
        rH2DischargeControlValve_Pct    := 0.0;
        rCoolantPumpDemand_Pct          := aControl_u[2];
        rCoolant3WayValve_Pct           := aControl_u[3];
        rAuxHeatingDemand_kW            := 0.0;
        
        (* PCM Latent Heat Thermal Buffer Management *)
        IF rPCMPlateCoreTemp_DegC > 34.5 THEN
            (* Paraffin melting initiated: augment secondary cooling loop flow *)
            rCoolantPumpDemand_Pct := 100.0;
            bChillerBypassContactor_Cmd := TRUE;
        ELSE
            bChillerBypassContactor_Cmd := FALSE;
        END_IF;
        
        (* Exothermic Runaway Protection Interlock *)
        IF rVotedBedTemp_DegC > 65.0 THEN
            bThermalRunawayLatched    := TRUE;
            rH2ChargeControlValve_Pct := 0.0;
            iOperatingState           := 99;
        END_IF;
        
        (* Transition Condition: State of Charge approaching target plateau limit *)
        IF rCurrentStateOfCharge_Pct >= 85.0 THEN
            iOperatingState := 45; (* Transition to finishing top-off *)
        ELSIF rCurrentStateOfCharge_Pct >= rTargetSoC_Pct THEN
            iOperatingState := 50; (* Reached target storage *)
        END_IF;

    45: (* ---------------- HYDRIDING SATURATION TOP-OFF & RATE TAPERING ---------------- *)
        bH2SafetyShutoffValve_Cmd       := TRUE;
        (* Progressive rate throttling to accommodate declining reaction kinetics *)
        rH2ChargeControlValve_Pct       := LIMIT(0.0, aControl_u[1] * 0.40, 25.0);
        rCoolantPumpDemand_Pct          := 60.0;
        rCoolant3WayValve_Pct           := 0.0;
        
        tPlateauTransitionTimer(IN := (rCurrentStateOfCharge_Pct >= rTargetSoC_Pct) OR (rH2MassFlow_Nm3h < 0.2), PT := T#2M);
        
        IF tPlateauTransitionTimer.Q THEN
            tPlateauTransitionTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iOperatingState := 50; (* Transition to Charged Storage *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* ---------------- CHARGED ISOTHERMAL STORAGE & STANDBY EQUILIBRIUM ---------------- *)
        bH2SafetyShutoffValve_Cmd       := TRUE;
        rH2ChargeControlValve_Pct       := 0.0;
        rH2DischargeControlValve_Pct    := 0.0;
        rCoolantPumpDemand_Pct          := 20.0; (* Low parasitic idle circulation *)
        rCoolant3WayValve_Pct           := 50.0;
        rAuxHeatingDemand_kW            := 0.0;
        
        (* Demand-Driven Mode Transitions *)
        IF bFuelCellRunPermit AND (rFuelCellDemandFlow_Nm3h > 0.2) THEN
            iOperatingState := 60; (* Fuel cell demands hydrogen *)
        ELSIF (rTargetSoC_Pct > (rCurrentStateOfCharge_Pct + 5.0)) AND (rH2SupplyPressure_bar > 15.0) THEN
            iOperatingState := 30; (* Top-up absorption requested *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* ---------------- DESORPTION PREHEAT RAMP & THERMAL SYNC COUPLING ---------------- *)
        (* Endothermic desorption requires thermal energy to sustain plateau delivery pressure *)
        bH2SafetyShutoffValve_Cmd       := TRUE;
        rH2ChargeControlValve_Pct       := 0.0;
        rCoolant3WayValve_Pct           := 100.0; (* 100% Heat Sync / Waste Heat Recovery *)
        rCoolantPumpDemand_Pct          := 75.0;
        rAuxHeatingDemand_kW            := LIMIT(0.0, rAuxHeaterAvailable_kW, 35.0);
        
        tEquilibrationSoakTimer(IN := (rVotedBedTemp_DegC >= 45.0), PT := T#1M);
        
        IF tEquilibrationSoakTimer.Q THEN
            tEquilibrationSoakTimer(IN := FALSE);
            nTotalDesorptionCycles := nTotalDesorptionCycles + 1;
            iOperatingState        := 70; (* Enter Dehydriding Discharge *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* ---------------- DEHYDRIDING ENDOTHERMIC DISCHARGE TO FUEL CELL ---------------- *)
        bH2SafetyShutoffValve_Cmd       := TRUE;
        rH2ChargeControlValve_Pct       := 0.0;
        
        (* Throttle Discharge Valve to Match Fuel Cell Flow Request while Guarding Backpressure *)
        IF rVotedBedPressure_bar < (rMinFuelCellDeliveryPress_bar + 0.5) THEN
            (* Fuel Cell Starvation Risk: Choke discharge valve to protect bed plateau *)
            rH2DischargeControlValve_Pct := LIMIT(5.0, (rVotedBedPressure_bar / rMinFuelCellDeliveryPress_bar) * 45.0, 60.0);
            bFuelCellStarvationRisk      := TRUE;
            wAlarmAggregatedWord.8       := TRUE;
        ELSE
            rH2DischargeControlValve_Pct := LIMIT(10.0, (rFuelCellDemandFlow_Nm3h / 45.0) * 100.0, 100.0);
            bFuelCellStarvationRisk      := FALSE;
            wAlarmAggregatedWord.8       := FALSE;
        END_IF;
        
        (* Modulate Thermal Sync to Maintain Plateau Desorption Temperature *)
        rCoolantPumpDemand_Pct          := aControl_u[2];
        rCoolant3WayValve_Pct           := 100.0;
        rAuxHeatingDemand_kW            := LIMIT(5.0, rReactionEnthalpyFlow_kW * 1.15, 45.0);
        
        (* Low State of Charge Transition *)
        IF rCurrentStateOfCharge_Pct <= 10.0 THEN
            iOperatingState := 75; (* Transition to Deep Depletion *)
        ELSIF (rFuelCellDemandFlow_Nm3h < 0.1) OR NOT bFuelCellRunPermit THEN
            iOperatingState := 50; (* Return to Standby *)
        END_IF;

    75: (* ---------------- DEEP DEPLETION & LOW-PRESSURE SCAVENGING ---------------- *)
        bH2SafetyShutoffValve_Cmd       := TRUE;
        rH2ChargeControlValve_Pct       := 0.0;
        rH2DischargeControlValve_Pct    := LIMIT(0.0, (rFuelCellDemandFlow_Nm3h / 45.0) * 50.0, 50.0);
        rAuxHeatingDemand_kW            := 25.0;
        
        IF (rCurrentStateOfCharge_Pct <= 3.0) OR (rVotedBedPressure_bar < rMinFuelCellDeliveryPress_bar) THEN
            rH2DischargeControlValve_Pct := 0.0;
            bFuelCellStarvationRisk      := TRUE;
            iOperatingState              := 50; (* Depleted, return to Standby *)
        END_IF;

    80: (* ---------------- PERIODIC THERMAL REGENERATION & VOLATILE DEGAS ---------------- *)
        (* High temperature bakeout (80 deg C) to desorb inert trace poisons *)
        bH2SafetyShutoffValve_Cmd       := FALSE;
        rH2ChargeControlValve_Pct       := 0.0;
        rH2DischargeControlValve_Pct    := 0.0;
        bInertGasPurgeValve_Cmd         := TRUE;
        rCoolant3WayValve_Pct           := 100.0;
        rCoolantPumpDemand_Pct          := 50.0;
        rAuxHeatingDemand_kW            := 40.0;
        
        tThermalRegenerationBakeTimer(IN := (rVotedBedTemp_DegC >= 78.0), PT := T#30M);
        
        IF tThermalRegenerationBakeTimer.Q THEN
            tThermalRegenerationBakeTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bInertGasPurgeValve_Cmd := FALSE;
            rAuxHeatingDemand_kW    := 0.0;
            iOperatingState         := 0; (* Regeneration complete *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* ---------------- DILATOMETRY STRESS MITIGATION & BACK-OFF ---------------- *)
        (* Active stress relief: stop hydriding, boost chilling to shrink bed, open micro-relief *)
        rH2ChargeControlValve_Pct       := 0.0;
        bH2SafetyShutoffValve_Cmd       := FALSE;
        rCoolant3WayValve_Pct           := 0.0;   (* Maximum chilling *)
        rCoolantPumpDemand_Pct          := 100.0; (* Maximum thermal dissipation *)
        rAuxHeatingDemand_kW            := 0.0;
        
        (* Soak timer for dilatometry stress relaxation *)
        tStressRelaxationTimer(IN := (rVotedWallStress_MPa < rStressWarningLimit_MPa), PT := T#5M);
        
        IF tStressRelaxationTimer.Q THEN
            tStressRelaxationTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bStressInterlockLatched := FALSE;
            iOperatingState         := 50; (* Resume Standby *)
        END_IF;

    95: (* ---------------- DEGRADED GRACEFUL OPERATION (DERATED PROFILE) ---------------- *)
        (* Permitted operation with 2oo2 sensor configuration under reduced boundaries *)
        bDegradedModeActive             := TRUE;
        rH2ChargeControlValve_Pct       := LIMIT(0.0, aControl_u[1] * 0.60, 40.0);
        rH2DischargeControlValve_Pct    := LIMIT(0.0, aControl_u[1] * 0.70, 50.0);
        rCoolantPumpDemand_Pct          := 75.0;
        
        tDegradedModeAnnunciatorTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#1M);
        IF tDegradedModeAnnunciatorTimer.Q THEN
            tDegradedModeAnnunciatorTimer(IN := FALSE);
            wAlarmAggregatedWord.9 := NOT wAlarmAggregatedWord.9; (* Flash degraded indicator *)
        END_IF;
        
        IF bDualChannelFailure THEN
            iOperatingState := 99; (* Drop to trip if redundancy fully collapses *)
        END_IF;

    98: (* ---------------- CONTROLLED RAPID SAFE DEPRESSURIZATION ---------------- *)
        bH2SafetyShutoffValve_Cmd       := FALSE;
        rH2ChargeControlValve_Pct       := 0.0;
        rH2DischargeControlValve_Pct    := 0.0;
        bEmergencyDepressValve_Cmd      := TRUE; (* Route hydrogen to atmospheric vent / flare *)
        rCoolantPumpDemand_Pct          := 100.0;
        bInertGasPurgeValve_Cmd         := TRUE; (* Nitrogen blanket displacement *)
        
        IF rVotedBedPressure_bar <= 1.2 THEN
            bEmergencyDepressValve_Cmd := FALSE;
            iOperatingState            := 99;
        END_IF;

    99: (* ---------------- CRITICAL EMERGENCY LOCKOUT TRIP ---------------- *)
        bH2SafetyShutoffValve_Cmd       := FALSE; (* Positive spring-return mechanical closure *)
        rH2ChargeControlValve_Pct       := 0.0;
        rH2DischargeControlValve_Pct    := 0.0;
        rCoolantPumpDemand_Pct          := 100.0; (* Continuous emergency heat removal *)
        rCoolant3WayValve_Pct           := 0.0;   (* Direct to emergency chiller *)
        rAuxHeatingDemand_kW            := 0.0;
        bEmergencyDepressValve_Cmd      := FALSE;
        bInertGasPurgeValve_Cmd         := FALSE;
        bAlarmCriticalTrip              := TRUE;
        
        (* Require Manual Physical Reset to Exit Lockout *)
        IF bEmergencyStop AND NOT bThermalRunawayLatched AND NOT bHydrogenLeakDetected AND NOT bStressInterlockLatched AND NOT bMasterEnable THEN
            bAlarmCriticalTrip := FALSE;
            iOperatingState    := 0; (* Reset permitted back to Idle Standby *)
        END_IF;

END_CASE;
